_note: Sample past incidents for find_similar_incidents. Replace them with your own resolved incidents and postmortems.

incidents.title: Checkout API 500 errors, too many connections
incidents.description: Checkout API returned HTTP 500 for about 30% of requests. Database logs showed too many connections and pool timeout errors.
incidents.root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by a connection leak in the order service
incidents.fix: Restarted order-service pods, then fixed the leak by closing connections in a finally block

incidents.title: Orders table deadlocks during batch import
incidents.description: Nightly import job and checkout both updating the orders table. Deadlock detected errors and slow checkout.
incidents.root_cause: Query deadlock between the batch import and checkout transactions
incidents.fix: Moved the import to off-peak hours and changed the update order to avoid lock cycles

incidents.title: Search service OOMKilled repeatedly
incidents.description: Search pods restarted every few hours with OOMKilled. Memory grew steadily after each restart.
incidents.root_cause: Memory leak in the query result cache which never evicted entries
incidents.fix: Added a size limit and eviction to the cache; scheduled restarts until the fix was deployed

incidents.title: API latency high, CPU saturated at 98%
incidents.description: Public API p99 latency above 3 seconds. CPU saturated on all nodes during a marketing campaign traffic spike.
incidents.root_cause: Traffic spike beyond capacity during a marketing campaign
incidents.fix: Scaled out the API from 6 to 15 replicas and added autoscaling rules

incidents.title: Payment gateway timeouts
incidents.description: Calls to the external payment gateway timed out. Users saw payment failures at checkout.
incidents.fix: Switched to the backup payment provider and enabled the circuit breaker

incidents.title: Internal services cannot resolve database hostname
incidents.description: Multiple services logged could not resolve host errors for the database endpoint after a DNS change.
incidents.root_cause: DNS resolution failure after a record was deleted during a DNS cleanup
incidents.fix: Restored the DNS record and added DNS change review

incidents.title: Log volume full on app servers
incidents.description: Application servers stopped writing data with no space left on device errors. Disk usage at 100%.
incidents.root_cause: Disk full because debug logging was left on and log rotation was missing
incidents.fix: Removed old logs, turned off debug logging and configured logrotate

incidents.title: NullPointerException after release 2.31
incidents.description: Checkout started throwing NullPointerException in PriceCalculator right after deploying version 2.31.
incidents.root_cause: Regression in a recent code change in the pricing module
incidents.fix: Rolled back to version 2.30, fixed the null check and added a unit test

incidents.title: Feature flag enabled new recommendation engine for all users
incidents.description: Error rate jumped after a feature flag was turned on for 100% of users instead of 5%.
incidents.root_cause: Configuration change to a feature flag rollout percentage
incidents.fix: Turned the flag back to 5% and added a review step for flag changes

incidents.title: TLS handshake failures on partner API
incidents.description: Partners reported SSL errors and certificate expired messages when calling our API.
incidents.root_cause: Expired TLS certificate on the partner API load balancer
incidents.fix: Renewed and installed the certificate; enabled auto-renewal and expiry alerts

incidents.title: Login traffic flood from many IPs
incidents.description: Login endpoint received a flood of requests from thousands of IPs. Suspicious traffic and brute force attempts.
incidents.root_cause: Credential stuffing attack against the login endpoint
incidents.fix: Enabled WAF rate limiting and bot protection; forced password resets for affected accounts

incidents.title: Email notifications failing with 429
incidents.description: Notification service received 429 Too Many Requests from the email provider and emails were delayed.
incidents.root_cause: Rate limiting by an external API after a bulk send
incidents.fix: Added a send queue with rate limiting and asked the provider for a higher quota
